caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of furniture consisting of a round mirror with a wooden frame mounted on top of a small, rectangular table with a drawer. The mirror has a decorative top and two small side knobs. The table is supported by a single, slender, vertically-oriented central leg that is intricately carved and extends downward to form four outward-curving feet at the base for stability. The tabletop appears to be a light blue or green color, while the rest of the object, including the mirror frame, table sides, drawer, central support, and feet, is rendered in shades of brown that mimic the appearance of wood. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details, giving the outlined and colored furniture piece full prominence in the composition. There is handwritten text near the bottom of the drawing.
title: Shaving Stand
